text:
Writers, stop writing "She realized."

Not this: She realized he had never loved her.
Try this: She scrolled his contacts. Three years, and he still had her saved as "Priya (work)."

Don't announce the realization. Hand over the evidence.

#writingcommunity

Rewrite in one line, without the word "realized":

"She realized the message wasn't from him."

Reply with yours. I'll quote-post my favourite tomorrow.
